# Paylix SDK
> Open-source, self-hostable crypto payments. One-time payments and subscriptions across 7 EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche) plus scaffolded Solana, Bitcoin and Litecoin. Tokens: USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC, PYUSD. Gasless checkout, non-custodial settlement.
